newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - August 5.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - August 5.

text.p: -- CIENA Corp said it expected third quarter earnings to be between $0.31 and $0.33 per share versus $0.10 per share in last year's third quarter and a First Call estimate of $0.27 per share. But it said investors should not be surprised to see moderating sequential growth in the fourth quarter and the first quarter of fiscal 1998. The stock closed at 54-3/16 then dipped as low as 51-1/2 after the close.

-- InteliData said it did not expect to meet consensus analysts' earnings expectations for 1997, citing gross margin pressures and investment in product development and sales. The stock closed at 4-8/16.

-- Furniture retailer Heilig-Meyers said its second quarter earnings for the period ending August 31 could come under pressure because of the sales short-fall in the first two months of the quarter. The stock closed at 17-3/8.
